scope: Author revision requirements and explicit prospective actions, not a new referee report or scientific-success declaration.

items.heading: B1. Neural specificity remains unestablished
items.exact_text:
### B1. Neural specificity remains unestablished

Validity, recursive qualification, the AVaR enclosure, the information lower bound, and the fallback are representation-neutral. The ReLU family is not the complete-work winner and is never certified adopted over quadratic least squares.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: The shared information theorem and original qualification remain representation-neutral. Exact ReLU/hinge identity now covers 96 paired files and 4,416 decisions. Fused qualification improves serving for multiple representations, but quadratic retains lower complete cost and original mean economic loss than ReLU. The separately frozen D validation adds independent original-primitive value bounds for all current delivered policies and retains all 56 arm comparisons. With the fixed left-minus-right arm ordering, the 56 contrasts comprise 32 strictly negative, 20 strictly positive, 2 exact-zero and 2 unresolved intervals. The two unresolved comparisons are quadratic versus the degree-two polynomial, one at each risk; the two exact zeros are ReLU versus the equivalent conventional hinge. The ReLU/ordinary-hinge equality and unchanged complete policies are explicit identities, so this validation supplies no architecture-exclusive economic gain.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: Neural-specific accuracy, information or adoption superiority is still not identified.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Give every neural, ordinary-hinge, quadratic, spline, polynomial, grid and original-model control the same new policy-improvement interface, original-value information, feasible action menu and qualification tolerance. Compare the resulting original-policy gains and complete costs against the strongest contemporaneous conventional service. The exactly equivalent hinge must receive the same acquired coefficients and a full standalone acquisition charge.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: A benefit from a common original-risk correction is a contribution to the NBO decision mechanism. It is not a neural-exclusive representation advantage. Any stronger neural claim requires a separate equal-information and equal-resource separation.
items.r120_empirical_status: pending; no R120 execution outcome supplied

items.heading: B2. The information-complexity result is too narrow for the platform claim
items.exact_text:
### B2. The information-complexity result is too narrow for the platform claim

The theorem is a specialized deterministic one-dimensional oracle result. It does not establish randomized, multivariate, nonuniform-law, or end-to-end Bellman complexity lower bounds.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: The information result is strengthened by an implementable paid-localization upper algorithm matching the lower order KR(1-alpha)/N^2 under one shared deterministic exact-point convention. The original investment certificate then carries the result into a real original-action calculation with finite-precision error paid.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: Randomized, nonuniform-law, multivariate and complete Bellman bit-complexity bounds remain outside the theorem, so broader platform complexity is not asserted.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Retain the completed R119 upper/lower rate with its exact point-information class and paid localization count. The proposed R120 advance must connect acquired accuracy to certified policy improvement or finite stopping under explicitly stated assumptions. Identify separately each exact-value query, uncertain value/support request and recursive terminal calculation; do not rename the R119 result as a newly proved R120 theorem.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: Optimal general randomized, nonuniform multivariate and complete learned Bellman complexity remain separate obligations unless actually proved. The scalar tail-uniform theorem does not pay for arbitrarily accurate floating-point values.
items.r120_empirical_status: pending; no R120 execution outcome supplied

items.heading: B3. The representation result is not decision-theoretic
items.exact_text:
### B3. The representation result is not decision-theoretic

The ridge example separates restricted approximation classes but does not separate policies, service work, or economic outcomes. A conventional method with the same hinge is equivalent.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: The representation comparison now includes a separately coded conventional oblique hinge carrying exactly the learned ReLU coefficients. Identical states/actions, certificates, rejected trials and complete policies are verified; differing clocks are attributed to implementation rather than neural expressiveness.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: An economic separation from conventional representations with the same features and resources remains unproved.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Use the original nonlinear investment objective to measure how the proposed action correction changes a realized constrained policy. Preserve the posted-price decision embedding and its exact conventional-hinge equality as a supporting economy. Report realized action changes, certified original-policy contrasts and action-distance bounds separately.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: A decision-changing shared correction does not prove that a neural learner discovers unknown geometry more efficiently. Results in the distinct posted-price economy cannot be reported as investment improvements.

### B4. The certificate-aware objective fails its intended service connection

It improves residual span in 36 of 36 cells but worsens aggregate rejections and most quadratic cells. The missing theorem is the connection from the trained objective to action-relevant resolution.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: We preserve all 36 favorable residual-span cells beside the increase from 644 to 757 rejections. New coupled-action, tail-defect and constrained-gap certificates target original action loss, while A/B/C empirically separate information reduction from actual decision-serving work. The inherited fitting objective itself is unchanged.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: A new trained acquisition loss with a proved rejection/work/policy-resolution link and prospective validation remains unimplemented.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Move the new intervention from certificate-only servicing to a candidate original action followed by an explicit, outward, complete-policy improvement test. A proposal generated from a critic or an original-value support must be checked under the original continuous risk law and the unchanged future controller. The proof must quantify its valid gain or accuracy requirement, include active action boundaries, and retain every unsuccessful proposal and fallback.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: This addresses the decision mechanism. If the acquisition remains the same least-squares fit, action-aware fitting itself is still unfinished. A genuine fitting-to-service claim additionally needs a specified action-aligned loss, an acquisition theorem and prospective validation of newly fitted actors.

items.heading: B5. Complete work favors a strong conventional method
items.exact_text:
### B5. Complete work favors a strong conventional method

Quadratic least squares is faster, uses fewer proposal queries, and has no neural acquisition overhead. R97 therefore does not shift the computational frontier toward NBO-specific representation.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: The complete current tables charge actual labels, candidates, audits, serialization, loading, proposal work and all refused certificates. Packed qualification is competitive as a common method, yet current quadratic with its best measured conventional service remains cheaper and has lower original catalogue-mean cost than ReLU. The cost account now includes the full additional D verification bill: The actual external process cost is 1697.331508 seconds, including 1697.251692 seconds measured inside the process and 1693.603548 CPU seconds; recorded peak resident memory is 83,152 KiB, and compressed primitive traces occupy 48,026,132 bytes. The separately executed completed-record audit costs a further 7.705036 elapsed and 7.538375 CPU seconds. These independently implemented value enclosures strengthen the economic comparison but are not inserted into or substituted for any competitive service clock. All conventional victories and all unresolved independent contrasts remain visible.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: No conventional victory is removed; a neural contribution that changes that full economic frontier remains to be demonstrated.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Run the strongest conventional controls contemporaneously under the same original model, tolerances and resources. Charge original labels, feature trials, fitting audits, serialization/loading, every proposed correction, failed comparison, certificate refinement, repair and complete service. Present the resource-versus-economic-cost frontier and both own-baseline and cross-representation contrasts.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: R119's conventional quadratic winner remains a historical fact. An improvement over a neural arm's own incumbent, or fewer calls in a shared algorithm, does not establish a new neural complete-cost frontier.

items.heading: B6. The purchase exercise is conditional sensitivity, not economic identification
items.exact_text:
### B6. The purchase exercise is conditional sensitivity, not economic identification

No learned service is adopted over quadratic least squares. Prices and fees are external, clocks are descriptive, and the policy interval is broad. The exercise does not change an economic conclusion.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: Current adoption is expressed as a sufficient inequality in actually observed acquisition/service components and an explicitly external economic price. All fifteen within-arm policy contrasts are exactly zero, and the quadratic/ReLU economic comparison is adverse rather than converted into a purchase success. D independently reports all 56 arm-mean cost intervals, and separately checks every one of the 240 within-arm service-pair identity cells. All 240 service-pair cells contain identical complete policies at every one of their 144 states, giving exact zero mean differences rather than an inference from overlapping intervals. This confirms the scope of the current policy comparison while adding no calibrated compute price, demand curve, fee or population adoption estimate.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: An identified workload, price/fee schedule, calibrated welfare scale and population adoption statement remain absent.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Compute original-policy gain intervals for the new returned actions and connect the remaining-gain stopping account to the actual paid correction work. Express any adoption comparison in consistent original-loss and resource units, with an explicitly stated workload. Keep a gain against an arm's own completed incumbent distinct from a gain against the best conventional policy.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: Symbolic price thresholds and deterministic catalogue means do not identify calibrated economic adoption. The historical zero-adoption-over-quadratic result and all unresolved regions remain intact.

items.heading: B10. The negative result is more compelling than the platform claim
items.exact_text:
### B10. The negative result is more compelling than the platform claim

The strongest new fact is that a valid global residual objective can fail to improve delivered decisions. The manuscript should either make that misalignment central or supply a new action-aligned objective and theorem.
items.inherited_r119_author_treatment: The failure of residual fitting to improve actions is made explicit and retained as a primary scientific finding. R119 advances action-valid qualification and paid risk acquisition; masking first fails in full time, and a separately frozen packed implementation then improves the same-information service without inventing policy gains.
items.inherited_r119_remaining_requirement: The stronger positive claim of an action-aligned trained acquisition objective remains open; certificate and implementation progress do not close it.
items.planned_r120_author_action: Make the historical residual-to-decision mismatch motivate an algorithm that can change the delivered original action and certifies its effect. State exactly what is new relative to the inherited completed-incumbent gate and remaining-gain bound: a quantitative proposal, accuracy, convergence or stopping result is needed beyond the observation that one disjoint interval is smaller than another.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: The R119 phases have exact-zero within-arm policy gains. R120 gains, if executed and certified, belong only to the new source and cannot retrospectively turn the R97 acquisition objective into successful action-aware learning.

Ask when a stored continuation can be safely purchased for recursive-risk dynamic decisions. Treat neural networks as one optional representation, not the source of validity.

### M6. Execute a consequential application or narrow the claim

Either calibrate policy margins, compute prices, fees, and workloads in an application where adoption matters, or state that the paper is about numerical certification rather than economic purchase.

Compute prices, fees, workloads and normalized-loss conversion are explicitly uncalibrated. D strengthens the direct original-economic value evidence with an exhaustive second implementation on the current catalogue. With the fixed left-minus-right arm ordering, the 56 contrasts comprise 32 strictly negative, 20 strictly positive, 2 exact-zero and 2 unresolved intervals. The two unresolved comparisons are quadratic versus the degree-two polynomial, one at each risk; the two exact zeros are ReLU versus the equivalent conventional hinge. It remains a two-date investment validation, with no newly calibrated welfare unit, compute price, workload population or enlarged application attached to it.

Relate any finite stopping rule to a proved upper bound on foregone original-policy gain. If an application supplies prices, workloads or welfare margins, fix and justify them independently of the numerical ranking.
items.continuing_scientific_boundary: A synthetic catalogue and a price-sensitivity inequality are not an empirically calibrated adoption decision. The goal of a substantive economic application remains active.
